title: Dirichlet nonvanishing at 0.8739465 by widening the density range
description: Extends the fixed natural-row density interface from a >= 33/40 to a >= 3/4 using its existing underlying maxima theorem. This supplies Sil's density-split HIGH branch on q in [1/2,3/4], removing the conservative q >= 13/20 gate. Fifteen exactly certified transitions extend Jacob Sussman's fine-chain count source from tracker PR 86 to G(977400389/1000000000,4383001/2000000,1/10); its step 38 is retained separately for the physical return. The return at h=80513/100000 has exact boundary 1747893/2000000=0.8739465, with the principal pole excluded. All claims retain the preprint's 7/8 theorem as input. Builds on OpenAI's preprint, Hailey Collet's density/source/count machinery, Sil's fourth-power and density-split construction, ArviFoxy's physical return, Jacob Sussman's fine chain, and Rohan Arun's preceding research. Research, certificate generation and formalization were substantially AI-assisted by OpenAI Codex. Inherited authorship and license notices are retained.
